data.one_liner: A CLI and library to refactor Flutter enum usages into dot-shorthand form.
data.what_it_does: It automatically refactors common Flutter enum usages like MainAxisAlignment.start into the new dot-shorthand form (.start). It can be run as a CLI command or used programmatically as a library.
use_when: You want to modernize a Flutter codebase to use the new dot-shorthand enum syntax.
You need a quick way to batch-replace 100+ common Flutter enums across your files.
avoid_when: You require an AST-based analyzer for precise type checking before transforming code.
You are working with custom enums that are not matched by regex and you don't want to specify them manually.
strengths: Supports 100+ common Flutter enums out of the box.
Zero dependencies and fast text-based transformation.
Can be used both as a CLI tool and programmatically as a library.
weaknesses: Text-based transformer rather than a full AST analyzer, which may be aggressive in unusual contexts.
May require manual review of the diff to ensure safety.
data.setup_notes: Add dot_shorthand_converter to your dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and run dart pub get.
